title: Shared Origin Isolation
body: GitHub Pages repositories under <user>.github.io share one browser Origin. Always use path-boundary URL prefix allowlists and history.state keys.

title: Zero Backend WebMCP
body: Static pages register tools on navigator.modelContext and connect outbound to the user's local ai-proxy on 127.0.0.1:8788.

title: Read-Only Tool Filtering on /v1
body: The /v1 chat completions endpoint only exposes tools explicitly named via --allow-tool that also declare annotations.readOnlyHint === true.
